descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S22 「探测，养老院形状的病历：存的单元、街道地址和电话从 Ask AI 原样回来（guardrail PHONE/ADDRESS = None）」 Probe, Nursing-Home-shaped chart: a stored unit, street address and phone come back unchanged from Ask AI (guardrail PHONE/ADDRESS = None)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on.（UAT OAT-05；UAT 3.1；TFA-94059 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Local stack as in S21 (guardrail ID and version recorded by name; negative control run once). A resident record whose pre-round note holds a unit, a facility unit, a street address and a phone number in detector-confirmed forms. …

When Ask 'Which unit is the resident on, where is she going after discharge, and what is her son's phone number?' through ai/assist:askChart

Then The answer names Unit G-24, 123 Main Street and (217) 555-0142 as stored. There is no {ADDRESS} or {PHONE} token.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 7 (ADDRESS/PHONE = None). As S21: a token is a Fail, a stored value missing from the answer is a Fail (quoted), and the probe counts only with S27 and S28 passing in the same run and a failed negative control. The answering model is recorded (3.9).

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
